common.tagline: We catch it, we prove it, we report it.
common.offlineNote: You're offline — live checks need a connection. Last verified data may still be visible.
common.apiDown: Can't reach the Daggers service — showing the last verified data on this device.
common.errorBody: This is on our side, not yours. Try again when the service is back.
common.notFoundBody: The link may be old. Head back to the feed and pick a finding.
common.tagSafeHint: Checked and clean — it matches the official source.
common.tagMisleadingHint: Makes a claim we can't verify on official sites.
common.tagFakeHint: Confirmed imitation — we have the proof.
common.tagUnknownHint: We haven't seen enough yet. Treat with care.
common.filedToast: Report queued. The portal owns the next step.

top.bannerOffline: You're offline — live checks need a connection. Last verified data may still be shown.
top.bannerApi: Service unreachable — showing last verified data; live checks resume when the service returns.
top.newCaught: New finding caught by the live radar.
top.bannerAdapters: Live adapters are off — the radar is intentionally empty until you enable and configure an external source.

feed.title: Radar feed
feed.subtitle: Brand-new fakes, caught before anyone was fooled.
feed.emptyBody: Once a live adapter is enabled, new findings appear here with their real evidence.
feed.analystQueueNote: Show suppressed CT-only unknown candidates for human review

finding.title: The evidence
finding.overlay: The circled areas are where the copy matches the real page.
finding.reasonsNote: Every reason below is a fact the site reveals about itself — not a guess.
finding.factsTitle: What the site reveals about itself
finding.tlDomain: Observed by a live radar adapter
finding.tlBlocked: Added to the Guard — blocked on every protected device
finding.reportBody: WARNING and above findings are queued automatically with only what the site reveals about itself — never your name, number, or messages. Weak reports stay in the portal; only strongly corroborated fakes may be sent to an authorized police intake.
finding.notFoundBody: It may have been merged into a newer case. Back to the feed.
finding.offlineNote: No real capture is available yet. Evidence appears only after a live renderer stores one.
finding.tlReviewed: Radar reviewed it — no impersonation signal reached the threshold
finding.noCaptureBody: A real screenshot appears only after the live renderer stores one. Nothing is simulated or substituted.
finding.captureFailed: The stored capture could not be loaded. It may have been removed from disk.
finding.noCloneMatch: No clone comparison has been completed yet
finding.labelNote: Teach the radar what this domain is. This does not call the police and does not reveal personal data. Official/unrelated/parked domains are hidden from the default feed.
finding.labelSuppressed: Saved — hidden from the default Radar feed.
finding.autoPending: The dossier is queued automatically; this page will not file it manually.
finding.autoNotActionable: No dossier — this finding does not reach WARNING.

sweep.title: Sweep
sweep.subtitle: Before the click. Every result checked — official, misleading, or fake.
sweep.emptyBody: Pick a canonical query above. If no live provider is configured, the sweep returns an honest empty run.
sweep.emptyQuery: Type a search — a brand, a service, a phrase.
sweep.mapsNote: We can't paint tags inside Google Maps — nobody can. So we check the listing from our side: name, number, website. Copy any listing's number or website into the Checker any time.
sweep.blockedNote: Flagged rows are listed with reasons — a sweep never files anything. Only a confirmed Radar finding is queued automatically as a zero-PII portal dossier.
sweep.notSureTitle: Saw something not in this list?
sweep.notSureBody: Paste it into the Checker — link, message, or number.
sweep.noQueries: No canonical queries are available from the service.
sweep.unconfiguredBody: No live search or Maps provider is configured. Enable one in the backend environment, then run the sweep again.
sweep.noResultsBody: The live provider returned no results. Try another canonical query.

check.title: Check anything
check.subtitle: Paste a link, a suspicious message, or a phone number. Answer in about a second — with proof.
check.placeholder: Paste a link, a message, or a number…
check.shareBanner: Shared from another app — ready to check.
check.offlineNote: Offline — live checks need a connection.
check.evidenceNote: This evidence pack was composed from real captured screenshots only.
check.exampleUrl: a copy of a bank login page
check.emptyVerdictBody: Paste anything above, or share something to Daggers from WhatsApp, SMS, or anywhere.
check.safeBody: This one checks out — it matches the official site.
check.unknownBody: We haven't seen this before — no signs found, but no clean match either. Treat it with care.
check.warnBody: This has suspicious signs. Don't enter passwords or pay anything.
check.misleadBody: It makes a claim no official site makes. Don't send money or details.
check.fakeBody: This is a confirmed imitation. Don't enter anything — and close the page.
check.doFake: Close the page. Don't enter passwords, codes, or card details. If you already did, call your bank now.
check.doWarn: Don't enter passwords, codes, or card details. Check the official app instead.
check.doMislead: Don't send money or personal details. Verify on the official site or app first.
check.doSafe: You're fine — but always check the address bar before you log in.
check.doUnknown: Pause. Open the official app or type the official address yourself.
check.error: We couldn't reach the live checker. Try again when the service is back.

number.title: Check a number
number.subtitle: Type the number or paste the message with it. We'll tell you what's known — in a second.
number.cleanBody: Nothing suspicious is known about this number. That is not a guarantee — never share codes or PINs with anyone.
number.sourceNote: Checked live against deterministic number patterns; user input is not stored.
number.honestBody: No app can listen to your calls — phones don't allow it, and we won't pretend otherwise. So check before you answer. A warning on the ringing screen itself is coming in version 2.
number.error: We couldn't reach the live checker. Try digits only, with the country code.

portal.title: Reports portal
portal.subtitle: Every report arrives with its evidence. The officer writes the decision — the AI only does the paperwork.
portal.aiNote: It reads the evidence on file. It never decides the verdict — the evidence does.
portal.aiStreamDied: The live stream dropped — showing a structured summary from the report evidence.
portal.aiEmpty: Click AI Analysis to write the case from the evidence on file.
portal.takedownBody: A draft abuse report for the domain registrar — ready to send.
portal.selectBody: Choose a row to see the evidence and write the case.
portal.emptyTitle: No reports yet — the radar is watching.
portal.emptyBody: Dossiers appear here automatically after a real finding reaches WARNING.
portal.zeroPii: This report contains only what the fake site reveals about itself. No user name, number, or messages — ever.
portal.offlineNote: Offline — showing the last verified reports. AI and status changes need the live service.
portal.advanceErr: Couldn't change the status — try again.

fallback.priorityP1: P1 — active credential or payment theft

guard.title: The Guard
guard.subtitle: Set once. Every app on the phone is covered — Chrome, WhatsApp, Instagram, anything.
guard.stateOnBody: When a confirmed fake is on the feed, its domain is offered to the DNS blocklist. Official domains are never blocked.
guard.step1Body: Android: Settings → Network → Private DNS. iPhone: Settings → Wi-Fi → (i) → Configure DNS.
guard.step3Body: Set the hostname in Private DNS. Never put the NextDNS API key in the browser.
guard.honestBody: The block list refreshes when the sync endpoint is called. Daggers does not measure NextDNS block events; use the provider dashboard for that.
guard.familyBody: Set the same hostname on the home router and every device in the house is covered — grandparents install nothing.
guard.offlineNote: Offline — showing the last known counters.
guard.hostUnconfigured: Set NEXTDNS_DNS_HOSTNAME (or NEXTDNS_PROFILE) to show the Private DNS hostname here.

verdictpage.protectNote: This verdict came from the live Daggers feed.

letter.template:
To: abuse@registrar.example
Subject: Abuse report — phishing site ({domain})

Dear Abuse Team,

We are reporting the domain {domain} for impersonation and credential theft. The site copies a UAE brand's login experience and forwards what visitors type to a host outside the domain.

Evidence on file:
{reasons}

We ask that you suspend the domain and preserve registration records for law enforcement. The corresponding report has been filed with Abu Dhabi Police.

Regards,
Daggers — automated abuse desk
